name: Luriquay

facts.text: Level 65, 10,000 health, in the Cursed Forest; when he dies a Flame (level 64) rises from him.
Bot chat: he haunts the cursed forest and has ended more groups than the werewolves.

story: Luriquay looks like nothing much, which is how he has ended more bands than anything else in the Cursed Forest. The Ardee folk say he is a lurikeen gone wrong, one of the small quick folk who stayed in the court wood when the bargain broke and drank from its fires. He carries one of them inside him now. Kill him and the fire comes out, a new Flame, as hungry as the old one. Bands who cheer his death too early learn this the warm way.
legend: He looks easy and is not: bring a proper group. When he dies a Flame rises from his body at once, so be ready for a second fight and keep heat resists up. The bands who cheer early are the ones the old hibs tell stories about.

aggro: Not as small as I look, am I?

phases.text: Something inside Luriquay starts to glow.

lairEntry: Tiny footprints in the ash, going in circles.

phases.text: A Flame bursts out of Luriquay's body!

atmosphere.realmFirstKill: Luriquay is dead, and so is the fire he carried.

briefing: luriquay is harder than he looks. when he dies [a flame spawns|fire comes out of him], be ready
aftermathWin: luriquay and his flame both down. [two for one|nice]
aftermathLoss: we cheered when luriquay died and [the flame ate the healer|then the fire came]
rumour: [heard|someone said] luriquay is a lurikeen who drank from the court wood's fires

loremasterTopic.text: A small quick one who stayed in the court wood and drank its fire. He carries a Flame inside him, and it comes out when he dies.
